== Worker Requisition ==
[[File:Worker Requisition.png|thumb|right|upright|420px|Worker Requisition]]
Bring this requisition form to the Kobold Foreman in a crystal collection [[challenge]] to increase the number of [[Kobold Union Worker|kobold workers]] you are allowed to hire. <!--Did not give a maximum kobold cap as it can change for future challenges-->

Acquired by:
* {{Verified|Killing boss monsters in any challenge. (~4-5% chance for them to drop a random challenge item)}}, [[Bound to Character]].
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear and Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], listed as Kobold Worker Requisition, [[Bound to Account]].

Usable in the following crystal collection challenges:
* {{Verified|'''[[Treasure of Crystal Cove]]'''}}
* '''Extraplanar Mining:'''
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time| Buying Time]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Buying Time - EPIC| Buying Time - EPIC]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage| Labor Shortage]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: Labor Shortage - EPIC| Labor Shortage - EPIC]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: The Dragon's Hoard| The Dragon's Hoard]]
** [[Extraplanar Palace: The Dragon's Hoard - EPIC| The Dragon's Hoard - EPIC]]
* '''Lava Caves:'''
** [[Lava Caves: Circles of Power|Circles of Power]]
** [[Lava Caves: Colossal Crystals|Colossal Crystals]]
** [[Lava Caves: Colossal Crystals - EPIC|Colossal Crystals - EPIC]]
** [[Lava Caves: Time is Money|Time is Money]]
** [[Lava Caves: Time is Money - EPIC|Time is Money - EPIC]]
